That's the pair of safeguards working as I'd want. I opened Edit, changed the title, hit Cancel — and my change just evaporated; the card stayed exactly as it was, so a bit of second-guessing while editing costs me nothing. Then I started a Delete, backed out of the confirmation, and the whole bookmark was still sitting there untouched — title, note, tags, all of it. That's the reassurance I need around the permanent delete: pulling back from the brink leaves everything precisely as it was.

So yes, those complete the two management pieces I asked for — editing anytime and deleting for good, each with a clean way to change my mind. Both feel right. What's next?
